title: Candlelight: Queen vs. ABBA
seo_title: Candlelight: Queen vs. ABBA in Springfield, MO
description: Candlelight: Queen vs. ABBA is a 60-minute tribute concert of Queen and ABBA music, performed under candlelight at Stone Chapel at Drury University. It is for ages 8 and up, and anyone under 16 must be accompanied by an adult. It takes place February 13, 2027 (time TBD) at 900 N Benton Ave in Springfield, MO, with tickets starting at USD 41; doors open 45 minutes before the show, there is no entry once it starts, and seating is first come, first served in each zone.
